description: Fetch the signature bundle for one signed document by signature assertion id (the signature_assertion_id inside the response value of a completed signature task). Returns the self-contained JSON an auditor can verify offline without trusting TaScan: the signed challenge preimage, clientDataJSON, authenticatorData, signature, public key, the user-verification and backup flags, the document SHA-256, task id, completion id and time. Contains no signed URL, phone number or email. Read tier, organization-scoped.

signature_assertion_id.description: signature_assertion_id (UUID) from the completion response value of a signature task

name: tascan_get_signature_bundle
